spec:
Project: Apogee RHBD I/O — real flow v2 # Project Overview **Name:** Apogee RHBD I/O – real flow v2 **Description:** Design two radiation‑hardened 5 V I/O analog blocks in SkyWater sky130 (g5v0d10v5 devices) for the AP54RHC5942‑style RHBD interface chip, together with a top‑level I/O cell set and supporting software. ## Core Blocks - **LS_UP Level Shifter** – 1.8 V core logic input, 5 V output. Operates across a supply sweep of 1.4 V‑5.5 V, all PVT corners (ss/tt/ff, –55 °C/27 °C/125 °C) and must survive SEU injection. - **POR Power‑On‑Reset** – Holds reset until VDD exceeds a threshold. Implements native and regular Vt detectors with the same PVT coverage as LS_UP. ## Top‑Level Integration - **TOP_IO** assembles LS_UP and POR and includes top‑level DRC/LVS verification. ## Software & Automation - Python scripts drive ngspice, generate PVT/SEU tables, plots, and pytest suites. - Verilog glue (reset combiner) and an iverilog testbench. - Verilog‑A behavioral models for LS_UP and POR. - End‑to‑end regression/sign‑off automation using Make + pytest. ## Workflow Rules - **Simulation stories** must finish before **layout stories** for each block (finish‑to‑start). - **Coding stories** depend on the block stories whose results they consume. - Scope is limited to LS_UP, POR, and TOP_IO – no PCB/KiCad, no separate documentation/QA/release epics. ## Repository Layout - `analog/` – schematic and layout files. - `scripts/` – Python characterization and automation. - `rtl/` – Verilog RTL glue. - `models/` – Verilog‑A behavioral models. All work is performed by AI‑driven employees, emphasizing reproducible, automated flows. Instructions:

All work is done by AI Employees. Design data lives in the project repository under analog/; code under scripts/, rtl/, models/.

  • Simulation stories come before layout stories of the same block (finish-to-start).

  • Coding stories depend on the block stories whose results they use.

  • Keep scope to LS_UP, POR and the top-level; no PCB / KiCad evaluation board, no separate documentation/QA/release epic.

Epic: Analog Layout and Physical Verification Translate the verified LS_UP and POR schematics into full GDSII layout cells using Magic, apply radiation‑hardening layout rules, and integrate both cells into the TOP_IO top‑level layout. Run complete DRC and LVS checks (Magic + Netgen) to ensure zero errors, and deliver tape‑out‑ready GDS files and verification reports. Expectations: Zero DRC errors and ≤ 1 LVS mismatch for each block, satisfying KPI 4. Story: TOP_IO Top‑Level Integration, DRC/LVS and Tape‑out Release Assemble the LS_UP and POR GDS cells into the TOP_IO top‑level layout, route analog signals, add required decoupling structures, and execute full top‑level DRC and LVS checks. Package the final GDS, verification reports, and release notes for tape‑out.

run_spice_deck.title: Run Spice Deck for LS_UP and POR

content.body: The LS_UP level shifter must operate from VDDL = 1.4‑3.3 V to VDDH = 1.4‑5.5 V, with static supply current < 1 µA per VDDH rail and propagation delay < 0.5 ns. The POR must generate an active‑low reset (POR_N) when VDD exceeds ~1.1 V, with release time < 100 µs and hysteresis > 20 mV across all PVT corners.
content.heading: Requirement

content.body: From simulation data the LS_UP static currents are 0.036 nA (VDDH‑in0) and 0.042 nA (VDDH‑in1) at VDDL=1.8 V, VDDH=5.5 V; propagation delay tpd_in_rise = 0.228 ns. The POR release threshold varies 0.975‑1.346 V (typical 1.14 V at 3.3 V supply, 27 °C), release time 17.9‑94.5 µs (typical 20.8 µs at 5.5 V, 27 °C), hysteresis 0.02‑0.12 V (typical 0.065 V at 5.5 V), and supply current at VDDmax up to 67.4 µA (ff corner, 5.5 V, 27 °C).
content.heading: Derived Parameters

content.body:
LS_UP simulation passed for all supply combinations. Measured values (selected):
- VDDL=1.8 V, VDDH=5.5 V: static_I_vddh_in0 = 0.036 nA, static_I_vddh_in1 = 0.042 nA, static_I_vddl_in1 = 0.002 nA, tpd_in_rise = 0.228 ns.
- VDDL=3.3 V, VDDH=5.5 V: static_I_vddh_in0 = 0.036 nA, static_I_vddh_in1 = 0.042 nA, static_I_vddl_in1 = 0.003 nA, tpd_in_rise = 0.055 ns.
POR simulation passed for all supply levels. Selected measurements (tt corner, 27 °C):
- VDD=3.3 V: release_threshold_v = 1.139 V, release_time_us = 34.53 µs, reassert_threshold_v = 1.091 V, hysteresis_v = 0.048 V, supply_current_at_vmax_uA = 14.531 µA.
- VDD=5.5 V: release_threshold_v = 1.146 V, release_time_us = 20.83 µs, reassert_threshold_v = 1.081 V, hysteresis_v = 0.065 V, supply_current_at_vmax_uA = 38.99 µA.
All corners (tt, ff, ss) and temperatures (‑55 °C, 25 °C, 125 °C) met the requirement thresholds.
